name: operatorok
description: The open catalog of plugins for Operator: skills, MCP servers and bots.

plugins.name: operator-research
plugins.description: Research skills from Operator: answer only from the documents with page citations, search the literature through Papers with Code, deliver a paper-style HTML report, and reproduce a paper honestly with a reviewer's verdict.

plugins.name: operator-reports
plugins.description: Writing skills from Operator: short scannable chat replies, a polished structured report, and a self-contained visual HTML report with stat cards, tables and charts.

plugins.name: operator-mac
plugins.description: Skills for jobs that look at a Mac without changing it: the four read-only rules every Mac report obeys, and the Apple-silicon tier table for choosing a local Ollama model that fits.

plugins.name: operator-engineering
plugins.description: Engineering skills from Operator: an OWASP-style security review, and honoring a job contract by delivering exactly the declared outputs as artifacts.

plugins.name: operator-trades
plugins.description: Talk like the trade: correct electrical terminology, safety-critical care, and code claims grounded in the source rather than guessed.

plugins.name: operator-mac-bots
plugins.description: Seven Mac teammates: Mac Housekeeping, Mac Doctor, Network, Security Check, Updates, Backup and Local Models. Each reads first, never sudo, and reports before it changes anything.

plugins.name: operator-team-bots
plugins.description: Two engineering crews: Review Team, which audits a codebase and requests reviews the way a careful reviewer would, and Startup Crew, which builds an app from a brief.

plugins.name: operator-real-estate-bots
plugins.description: Real-estate teammates: Listing Writer drafts listings, Follow-up Agent drafts lead follow-ups that never send without your yes, and Showing Coordinator schedules showings.

plugins.name: operator-manufacturing-bots
plugins.description: Shop-floor teammates: CNC Expert answers machining questions, SOP Builder turns a process into a standard operating procedure, and QA Inspector writes first-article inspection reports.

plugins.name: hermes-skills
plugins.description: The Hermes Agent skills tree from Nous Research: software development, research, creative, productivity, email, Apple apps, media, note-taking and more. MIT, © 2025 Nous Research.

plugins.name: vercel
plugins.description: Vercel: deployments, build status, logs and domains from the agent.

plugins.name: sentry
plugins.description: Sentry: error reports, stack traces and issue search for debugging production.

plugins.name: chrome-devtools
plugins.description: Chrome DevTools MCP: drive and inspect a live Chrome — performance traces, network, console, automation.

plugins.name: cloudflare
plugins.description: Cloudflare developer platform skills: Workers, Durable Objects, Agents SDK, MCP servers, Wrangler, web performance.

plugins.name: superpowers
plugins.description: obra/superpowers: a core skills library for software work — test-driven development, systematic debugging, collaboration patterns.

plugins.name: base44
plugins.description: Base44: build and deploy full-stack apps with its CLI and SDK.

plugins.name: mongodb
plugins.description: MongoDB self-managed MCP server and skills: explore data, manage collections, optimize queries against any deployment.

plugins.name: mongodb-atlas
plugins.description: MongoDB Atlas managed MCP server and skills: clusters, projects, users, network access, plus the data skills.

plugins.name: axiom
plugins.description: Axiom observability: APL queries over logs and metrics, SRE investigations, dashboards, monitors and cost analysis.

plugins.name: neon
plugins.description: Neon serverless Postgres: MCP server plus skills for projects, databases, connection methods and branches.

plugins.name: wix
plugins.description: Wix: CLI development skills and the Wix MCP server for sites, eCommerce, CMS and dashboard extensions.

plugins.name: netlify
plugins.description: Netlify platform skills: functions, Blobs, Postgres, Image CDN, forms, identity, caching, the CLI and deploys.

plugins.name: firecrawl
plugins.description: Firecrawl: search, scrape, map, crawl and extract live web data as LLM-ready markdown through its hosted MCP server.

plugins.name: figma
plugins.description: Figma MCP server and skills for design-to-code: read design context, implement designs, Code Connect, write to the canvas.

plugins.name: exa
plugins.description: Exa web search for agents: real-time search that reads relevant pages and answers with sources.

plugins.name: tavily
plugins.description: Tavily: web search, extraction, crawling and deep research through its hosted MCP server.

plugins.name: railway
plugins.description: Railway: projects, services, databases, deploys, environments, variables, domains and metrics.

plugins.name: stripe
plugins.description: Stripe: best practices, API and SDK upgrade guidance, and the Stripe MCP server.

plugins.name: tinyfish
plugins.description: TinyFish: web search, extraction and goal-driven browser automation on live sites through its hosted MCP server.

plugins.name: pstack
plugins.description: pstack (poteto-mode): agent playbooks for writing less, higher-quality code — investigation, design, review, verification.

plugins.name: browser-use
plugins.description: Browser Use: give the agent a real browser — your own Chrome with its logins, or an isolated cloud browser — for browsing, forms, scraping and testing.

plugins.name: quo
plugins.description: Quo (OpenPhone) MCP: SMS, contacts, tasks, message history and call transcripts through a hosted OAuth server.
